title: Login bug fix: the date is said out loud

lines.speaker: anna
lines.text: Hi, it's Monday, October 5th, 2026. I'm Anna, the project manager.

lines.speaker: anna
lines.text: Quick sync on the login bug. How bad is it?

lines.speaker: mark
lines.text: Some users get logged out after a few minutes. I found the cause this morning.

lines.speaker: anna
lines.text: Good. Can you deploy the fix tomorrow?

lines.speaker: mark
lines.text: Yes, I'll deploy it tomorrow morning.

lines.speaker: anna
lines.text: Great. Then I'll run the QA pass by Friday.

lines.speaker: mark
lines.text: Sounds good. Should we tell the support team?

lines.speaker: anna
lines.text: Yes, I'll email them today so they know what to say to customers.

lines.speaker: anna
lines.text: And let's do a short review of the incident on Wednesday next week.
